author: Chicoman69
text_post: The cool thing about retail is that most times they will train you to do the job.  I have worked retail most of my career.  The best way I have found is to just go into the store and fill out an application there.  I worked at Mervyn's here in the US before it shut down.  I also worked retail at a local lumberyard, then Salvation Army and finally landed a job with Walmart.  If you like clothing, then by all means, browse the mall near you and apply to the stores you like.   Read books on sales if you need help in this area...  Best of luck to you. -Chicoman
